title: NAFEMS LE1, elliptic membrane
description: Quarter of an elliptic membrane: inner ellipse (x/2)^2 + (y/1)^2 = 1, outer ellipse (x/3.25)^2 + (y/2.75)^2 = 1 (metres, modelled in mm), 0.1 m thick, steel (E 210 GPa, nu 0.3), 10 MPa outward pressure (a pull) on the outer edge, symmetry on the x and y axes. Plane stress, modelled as a thin 3D plate free in z: the plate is symmetric about its mid-plane, so the half 50 mm thick is modelled and slides on z = 0, which holds it in z and nothing else. No selector picks the elliptic outer face, so the harness takes the largest curved face from list_faces. D = (2, 0) is on the inner edge, where the tangential stress is sigma_yy. NAFEMS's coarse and fine meshes are quadrilaterals; these are Gmsh tetrahedra of 500 and 100 mm. The outer face is 50 mm thick but metres long, so fea_results does not flag its load as concentrated, even on the 500 mm mesh.

quantities.label: Tangential stress sigma_yy at D, coarse mesh
quantities.citation: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, 1990, test LE1
quantities.tolerance_reason: NAFEMS gives 92.7 MPa to three figures. D is where the inner edge curves most (radius 0.5 m), so a coarse mesh misses part of the peak.

quantities.label: Tangential stress sigma_yy at D, fine mesh
quantities.citation: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, 1990, test LE1
quantities.tolerance_reason: NAFEMS gives 92.7 MPa to three figures. The fine mesh follows the curvature at D; what is left is the extrapolation of stress to the free edge.
